first.outcome_source: FinnGen N14_ENDOMETRIOSIS (release and case counts not stated; 377,277 participants)

first.notes: OR per 1 mmol/l higher TG proxied by variants within +/-100 kb of ANGPTL3 (P<5e-8, r2<0.3); exposure defined as TG-raising, so paper reads it as ANGPTL3 agonism protective (inhibitors not supported). PFDR=0.04; called 'suggestive' because coloc PP.H4=0.85% (recorded 0.0085). LPL, PPARA, APOC3 null. Drug-target MR run only in the EUR discovery outcome; no replication. Outcome is the non-23andMe European meta.

title: Associations between granulysin and ovarian endometriosis: A 2-sample Mendelian randomization study.

claims.exposure_source: IEU OpenGWAS GNLY (ENSG00000115523), stated as 'SSGAC', n=31,684 (ID and n match eQTLGen, Vosa 2021)

first.source_location: Results section 4 text and Abstract; Table 1 (rounded 0.89, 0.82-0.96)
first.outcome_source: FinnGen ovarian endometriosis (via IEU OpenGWAS; endpoint ID not given)
first.notes: Single-exposure study; alpha 0.05, no multiple-testing correction. Exposure described as granulysin/'GNLY expression'; Ensembl gene ID and n suggest blood eQTL data, recorded as eQTL, tissue not stated. IVs P<5e-8, r2<0.001, 10,000 kb. Table 1: weighted median 0.87 (0.80-0.95) P=.003, MR-Egger 0.89 (0.79-0.99) P=.068, Q=9.06; text says WM/Egger P>.05 (disagrees with table). 3,231/68,969 matches FinnGen R5 ovarian endpoint.
